entities.name: Kingdom of Morgannwg
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Morgannwg was a kingdom in south-east Wales. It was a name for the Kingdom of Glywysing which came into use at the end of the tenth century and ended with conquest by the Normans around 1091.
